$Comment: The binding row for the Headless Horseman's hard ride (EncounterManager/Hallows_Eve/
Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter_Hard.json), the twin of his normal fight's row beside this
file. It names the fight with his hard name (NameKey, on the bar's Records tab and every line that
names it), binds the boss the library credits through the script's Boss slot in both his forms,
and keeps the hard fight's records on Records' Boss Fights under a bucket of their own,
hallows_eve_headless_horseman_hard, split by how many fought him (ByPartySize), so a hard win is
never ranked against a normal one.
Participation and Feedback are the normal row's, so a share of his hard daily Claim is earned the
same way and the same banner and toasts teach the fight: damage to his body (DamageDealt, the
server rule's 1.0), to his Head and his Jack Skeletons (DamageToAdds), damage taken (DamageTaken)
and every second in the fight (Presence), each times its weight. Change a weight in both rows
Progression.Feats names the feat Lanterns_Only: a hard win where every hit on him came from a
Lantern Bomb, which the hard ride's Lamplighter achievement counts.
It writes no Scale (his hard fight scales his health with the party itself) and no Loot (his hard
script pays his two hard Claims). Switch the row off with Enabled false, or from
